comment: The ComfyUI graphs this app can drive, and where to write a job's values into each.
Templates are generated by scripts/comfy-export-workflow.py from the saved workflows
in ComfyUI; the command that produced each one is recorded in `generated_by` so a
changed graph can be re-exported and diffed rather than hand-edited here.
`enlarges` is the honest claim, not a capability flag: only a graph that actually
resamples up to a requested size may set it. A graph that edits at its own working
resolution would have to say so instead, and the app would report the resample.
`model_scale` is the factor a graph's model stage produces before the graph's own
resize to the target. Only a graph whose upscaling is one fixed-factor model pass can
state it, and it exists so the finishing sharpen knows how far the graph itself

workflows.name: Faithful illustration upscale
workflows.description: Enlarges anime, line art, and digital illustration with the compact Real-ESRGAN x4 anime model, then resizes once to the exact target. It keeps the source composition and does not use prompts, latent diffusion, reframing, or face generation.
workflows.warning: This is reconstructive super-resolution, not a recovery of detail that no longer exists. It can infer small edge and texture patterns, so inspect fine lettering and tiny features at 1:1.
workflows.differs_from_source: Authored in this repository as a small, inspectable pixel-space graph. The source workflow is checked in so the exact model, resize, alpha path, and websocket output can be opened in ComfyUI.
